faults.description: A web-app release (new account switcher) sends portfolio requests without the required account_id, so portfolio-svc rejects them with 400 and the page errors.

decisive.contains: rejected request from web-app/5.2.0: 400 missing required parameter 'account_id'

trap: the errors are logged by the callee (portfolio-svc, which also deployed recently) but the cause is the caller's release
